name: The train lab's test line
_doc: Step 1's line, as data (step 2, #551): 1.5 km south then east of town on the flat. A 400 m straight south, a left-hand bend of 120 m radius (90 degrees, 30 m spirals) turning it east, 2.5 % up 750-1050 (7.5 m on a fill) and 2.5 % down to 1350, level to the end at 1500. The depot (mark A in step 1) at 120, the mine (B) at 1440. climb_foot, crest and descent_foot are the lab's scenario points.
